resources.string: 1. What is a PDF Editor?

A PDF Editor allows you to modify PDF documents by editing text, changing fonts, adding images, inserting signatures, highlighting content, annotating pages, organizing documents, and saving your changes without recreating the file.
2. What editing tools are available in the app?

The app includes a wide range of editing tools such as Text Edit, Font Change, Font Size Adjustment, Bold, Italic, Underline, Text Color, Highlight, Strike-through, Add Images, Insert Shapes, Draw with Pen, Add Comments, Digital Signature, and Page Management tools.
3. Can I edit the text inside any PDF?

You can edit text in most editable PDF documents. However, scanned or image-based PDFs do not contain selectable text. These documents must first be converted into editable text using OCR (Optical Character Recognition) if the feature is available.
4. How do I change the font, size, or color of text?

Select the text you want to modify, then use the editing toolbar to choose a different font family, adjust the font size, change the text color, or apply formatting such as bold, italic, or underline.
5. How can I highlight or annotate a PDF?
Open the document and select the Highlight or Annotation tool. You can highlight important text, add comments, draw freehand, insert shapes, or place sticky notes anywhere on the page.
6. Can I add my signature to a PDF?
Yes. You can create a signature by drawing it with your finger or stylus, typing your name, or importing an image of your signature. Once created, it can be placed anywhere within the document.
7. Can I insert images or logos into a PDF?
Yes. You can import images from your device and position, resize, or rotate them within the PDF. This is useful for adding company logos, photos, stamps, or other graphics.
8. What page management features are available?
The app allows you to reorder pages, rotate pages, delete unwanted pages, duplicate pages, extract selected pages, merge multiple PDFs into one file, and split a PDF into separate documents.
9. Does the app support scanned PDF documents?
Yes. Scanned PDFs can be viewed normally. Editing the text inside a scanned document requires OCR technology to recognize the text. Without OCR, only annotations or image-based edits are possible.
10. Why does the app request storage or file access permission?
Storage or file access permission is required so the app can open, edit, save, import, export, and share PDF documents stored on your device. Your files remain under your control.
11. Will my documents remain private?
Yes. Your PDF files are processed locally on your device whenever possible. The app does not upload your personal documents unless you explicitly choose a cloud storage or sharing feature.
12. Can I share or export my edited PDF?
Yes. After editing, you can save the document and share it using email, messaging apps, cloud storage services, or any compatible application installed on your device.
13. Which file formats does the app support?
The app primarily supports PDF documents and may also allow importing images such as JPG, JPEG, and PNG for conversion into PDFs or insertion into existing PDF files.
14. Why can\'t I edit some PDF files?

Some PDF files are password-protected, digitally secured, corrupted, or created as scanned images. These limitations may prevent direct text editing until the document is unlocked or processed with OCR.
15. How can I report a problem or request a new feature?

If you experience any issues or have suggestions, please use the Contact Us or Feedback section within the app. Include your device model, Android version, and a brief description of the issue to help us improve your experience.
